evidence.reason: The cleanup list and try/finally are established only after both fixtures are created: seed_drain_work runs at line 980 and spawn_detached at line 981, while cleanup = [] and try begin at lines 982-983. If spawn_detached fails after the seed succeeds, control never reaches the cleanup scope, so the seeded run/child metadata is not released. The same setup-order defect applies to the cited analogous fixture sites. This is an ordinary resource-cleanup bug in the existing harness, not a new requirement or architectural change.
